run.command: yardr group add builders --runner herdr --limit 2 --set kind=claude --set args=--verbose --set prompt=/synthetic/yard/roles-in/builder.md
run.description: Add a new group without replacing one
does: adds the group builders on the herdr runner, with limit 2.
It sets no env_file: the operator gives one in a terminal, with yardr group set builders env_file=<file>.

On approval the yard writes the text below to the file /synthetic/yard/roles/builders.14bf1773d06d49439c44d99cc36cb82413edabdbfd8df091101dfda1dc96ad3d.md, read-only. Each session reads that file when it starts, so changing the file the ask names later changes no session:
Each session will start with the model a-line-of-the-role.

weight.line: brings a program the yard will run: a new group builders on the herdr runner, whose sessions the yard will start as the card shows
